title: SkillMutator: Benchmarking and Defending Language-and-Code Cross-modal Attacks on LLM Agent Skills
description: Artifact for the ACSAC 2026 paper "SkillMutator: Benchmarking and Defending Language-and-Code Cross-modal Attacks on LLM Agent Skills." The bundle reproduces every paper table and figure (Tables III-XI, Figures 4-6) from bundled scanner-verdict data via per-claim run.sh scripts that check recomputed metrics against machine-readable golden values, and it ships the end-to-end code (SkillMutator mutation pipeline and the fine-tuning framework) for full live regeneration. Tier 1 claim verification runs on public research infrastructure (any CPU, no GPU, no API key); full end-to-end reproduction additionally needs an NVIDIA A100 80 GB and an OpenAI API key. Adversarial (mutated) Agent Skills are included only as scanner inputs for install-time detection research and must be used in an isolated environment; injected malicious instruction text is not redistributed (verdicts and aggregates only).
